name: Amazon Redshift
shortInfo: Stream data from a user determined warehouse to an Amazon Redshift warehouse
brief: Redshift Reverse ETL connector enables streaming data from a data warehouse to a Redshift warehouse through DataChannel. This happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant syncs and determined an update frequency.
about: Amazon Redshift is one of the most popular, scalable, easy to manage data warehouse options for those wanting to setup a Data Warehouse on the cloud. Read more about the features and how to get started with the popular platform from AWS [here](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/index.html).
availableSync:
[Export](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/redshift/syncs/export.html)

This sync can be used to load data from your data warehouse into Redshift platform.
